title: Introduction to Machine Learning
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: Covers statistical decision theory, linear regression and classification, SVMs, neural networks, decision trees, ensembles, graphical models, clustering, EM and an introduction to learning theory and reinforcement learning. Assumes basic probability, linear algebra and programming.

title: Probability and Statistics
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: Axioms of probability, random variables and standard distributions, joint distributions, sampling distributions, estimation (MLE, UMVUE), confidence intervals and hypothesis testing.

title: OpenIntro Statistics
description: Introductory statistics textbook: data collection, distributions, foundations of inference, inference for numerical and categorical data, and linear and logistic regression.
